walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Food Technology specification.

Principles of Nutrition appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Principles of Nutrition in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Principles of Nutrition.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
